title: China Market Crash: Anatomy of a Liquidity Meltdown
objective: Deconstruct China's $2.4T equity collapse as an escalating reflexive deleveraging cascade using focal compositions, systematic typography, purposeful pacing, and continuous motion continuity.
audience: Informed viewers seeking a clear, high-production visual explanation of market microstructures, retail sentiment, and margin leverage.

message.core_message: When retail investors trade on borrowed money, even a small drop mathematically breaches collateral thresholds, triggering an automated panic stampede where state bailouts cannot print confidence.
key_points: Ten weeks of continuous decline erased over two trillion dollars in market valuation.
Triple margin debt mathematically triggers 100% collateral wipeouts on small drops.
90% retail trading dominance turns algorithmic margin calls into a synchronized stampede.
State intervention cannot print confidence without real corporate earnings repair.

constraints: Strictly enforce typography floor (>=22.3px in 720p / 33.5px in 1080p)
Anti-Laziness Mandate: Zero static visual freezes while narration is speaking
Focal stage occupancy >= 65% to eliminate accidental empty space
Preserve verified factual historical data from research dossier

research.reason: Directly based on validated research dossier in projects/china-market-crash-2026/research.json

creative_directions.name: Warm High-Contrast Editorial
creative_directions.concept: Warm ivory canvas (#FBFBFA) paired with punchy terracotta (#ba4128), electric ultramarine (#1d4ed8), and charcoal typography. Employs focal viewports commanding >70% frame area: dynamic Catmull-Rom spline surge, mechanical radial liquidation gauge, order vacuum comparison, and monumental concluding stat.

visual_identity.typography: JetBrains Mono kicker, Inter display/body, Playfair accent
visual_identity.texture: Subtle paper tooth and clean vector geometries

motion_language.transitions: Cinematic zoomThrough forward dive, directional wipe, and matchCut

composition.approach: Dominant hero stages (heroStage, splitStage, monumentStat) occupying 70%+ frame with balanced negative space

creative_directions.pacing: Starts measured and analytical, accelerates through mechanical liquidation and retail stampede, resolves into steady monumental reflection
creative_directions.why_it_fits: Delivers professional editorial authority while maintaining high viewer engagement and zero dead time.

creative_directions.name: Minimalist Swiss Terminal
creative_directions.concept: High-density technical grid with black-and-white telemetry and sparse accent lines.

visual_identity.palette: Clean white, stark black, single signal amber

creative_directions.why_it_fits: Strong technical feel, but less visually expressive than editorial motion storytelling.

success_criteria: Zero visual freezes exceeding 2.0s during narration
All text adheres to readability floor (>=22.3px)
Focal visuals fill 65%-80% of canvas area
